title: Department of Computer Science and Engineering
content: The Department of Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) at SRM is one of the largest and most prestigious departments. It offers B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering, along with several highly sought-after specializations including Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, Cyber Security, Cloud Computing, Big Data Analytics, Internet of Things (IoT), Software Engineering, and Computer Systems. The department boasts state-of-the-art laboratory facilities, high-performance computing clusters, and specialized labs in collaboration with tech giants like IBM, Cisco, and NVIDIA. Students get exposure to cutting-edge research in domains like Deep Learning, Bioinformatics, Blockchain, and Robotics. CSE graduates are highly recruited by premier technology firms globally, achieving record-breaking placements annually.
